en.setting: A warship rides at anchor three days from port, her decks creaking in the dark swell. The gun deck lanterns are doused for the middle watch, and below in the orlop hold, prize chests sit in rows between barrels and shadows. The cargo count is due at dawn.
en.crime: Quartermaster Cole was found in the orlop hold between two prize chests. A signal halyard was wrapped around his neck and his eyes were open.

suspects.name: Surgeon Graves
suspects.intro: The ship's surgeon, whose clean hands still carry ink and whose cabin holds a second set of accounts.

suspects.name: Bosun Flint
suspects.intro: Quarrelled with Cole over ration weights the previous watch, belaying pin in hand.

suspects.name: Captain Hale
suspects.intro: Keeps the prize ledger locked in his cabin chest, claims not to have opened it since port.

suspects.name: Navigator Reid
suspects.intro: Charted a course two points off heading, with a folded note in his compass case.

suspects.name: Powder Monkey Sam
suspects.intro: Carried rum to the gun deck at the start of the watch and heard nothing from below.

suspects.name: First Mate Darcy
suspects.intro: Had the watch and was responsible for all movement on deck, his log entry four lines short.

suspects.name: Carpenter Hook
suspects.intro: Had patched a seam in the hold that afternoon, his tools still below when the body was found.

es.setting: Un buque de guerra fondea a tres dias de puerto, sus cubiertas crujiendo en la marejada oscura. Las linternas de la cubierta de canones estan apagadas para la guardia media, y abajo en la bodega, los cofres de botin se alinean entre barriles y sombras. El conteo de carga esta previsto al amanecer.
es.crime: El contramaestre Cole fue encontrado en la bodega entre dos cofres de botin. Un driza de senales estaba enrollada alrededor de su cuello y sus ojos estaban abiertos.

suspects.name: Cirujano Graves
suspects.intro: El cirujano del barco, cuyas manos limpias aun llevan tinta y cuya cabina guarda un segundo juego de cuentas.

suspects.name: Contramaestre Flint
suspects.intro: Discutio con Cole sobre los pesos de las raciones en la guardia anterior, cabilla en mano.

suspects.name: Capitan Hale
suspects.intro: Guarda el libro de presas bajo llave en su cofre de camarote, afirma no haberlo abierto desde el puerto.

suspects.name: Navegante Reid
suspects.intro: Trazo un rumbo dos puntos desviado, con una nota doblada en su estuche de brujula.

suspects.name: Grumete Sam
suspects.intro: Llevo ron a la cubierta de canones al inicio de la guardia y no oyo nada desde abajo.

suspects.name: Primer Oficial Darcy
suspects.intro: Estaba de guardia y era responsable de todo movimiento en cubierta, su registro cuatro lineas mas corto de lo habitual.

suspects.name: Carpintero Hook
suspects.intro: Habia reparado una costura en la bodega esa tarde, sus herramientas aun abajo cuando se encontro el cuerpo.

fr.setting: Un navire de guerre mouille a trois jours du port, ses ponts craquant dans la houle sombre. Les lanternes du pont des canons sont eteintes pour le quart de minuit, et en bas dans la cale, les coffres de prises s'alignent entre les tonneaux et les ombres. Le comptage de la cargaison est prevu a l'aube.
fr.crime: Le quartier-maitre Cole a ete trouve dans la cale entre deux coffres de prises. Une drisse de signaux etait enroulee autour de son cou et ses yeux etaient ouverts.

suspects.name: Chirurgien Graves
suspects.intro: Le chirurgien du navire, dont les mains propres portent encore de l'encre et dont la cabine abrite un second jeu de comptes.

suspects.name: Maitre d'Equipage Flint
suspects.intro: S'est querelle avec Cole au sujet des poids de rations lors du quart precedent, cabillot en main.

suspects.name: Capitaine Hale
suspects.intro: Garde le registre des prises verrouille dans son coffre de cabine, affirme ne pas l'avoir ouvert depuis le port.

suspects.name: Navigateur Reid
suspects.intro: A trace une route deviee de deux points, avec une note pliee dans son etui a compas.

suspects.name: Mousse Sam
suspects.intro: A apporte le rhum au pont des canons au debut du quart et n'a rien entendu d'en bas.

suspects.name: Second Darcy
suspects.intro: Etait de quart et responsable de tout mouvement sur le pont, son journal de quatre lignes plus court que d'habitude.

suspects.name: Charpentier Hook
suspects.intro: Avait repare une couture dans la cale cet apres-midi, ses outils encore en bas quand le corps a ete trouve.

all_strong.en: Surgeon Graves had skimmed four hundred pounds across three prize captures, and Quartermaster Cole's cargo count would have exposed every doctored entry. The halyard was coiled wrong — left-handed, not sailor's fashion — and the knot was a surgeon's bend. The false accounts in his cabin, the ink under his nails, the gold dust on the coin pouch: each piece drew the noose tighter than the one around Cole's neck. Three days from port, the ship had its answer.
all_strong.es: El Cirujano Graves habia desviado cuatrocientas libras de tres capturas de presas, y el conteo de carga del Contramaestre Cole habria expuesto cada entrada manipulada. La driza estaba enrollada al reves — a izquierdas, no al estilo marinero — y el nudo era un nudo de cirujano. Las cuentas falsas en su cabina, la tinta bajo sus unas, el polvo de oro en la bolsa de monedas: cada pieza apretaba la soga mas que la que rodeaba el cuello de Cole. A tres dias de puerto, el barco tuvo su respuesta.
all_strong.fr: Le Chirurgien Graves avait detourne quatre cents livres sur trois prises, et le comptage du Quartier-maitre Cole aurait revele chaque ecriture falsifiee. La drisse etait lovee a l'envers — a gauche, pas a la maniere des marins — et le noeud etait un noeud de chirurgien. Les faux comptes dans sa cabine, l'encre sous ses ongles, la poussiere d'or sur la bourse : chaque piece serrait le noeud plus fort que celui autour du cou de Cole. A trois jours du port, le navire avait sa reponse.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Every man aboard suspected the surgeon, but the sea has a way of swallowing proof. The rope told one story, the ledger another, and neither spoke clearly enough for a court martial. Graves was confined to his cabin for the remaining three days, and the captain wrote a report that satisfied the admiralty without satisfying justice. The prize shares were paid out, and the matter was buried at sea.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: Todos a bordo sospechaban del cirujano, pero el mar tiene una forma de tragarse las pruebas. La cuerda contaba una historia, el libro de cuentas otra, y ninguno hablaba con suficiente claridad para un consejo de guerra. Graves fue confinado en su cabina los tres dias restantes, y el capitan escribio un informe que satisfizo al almirantazgo sin satisfacer a la justicia. Las partes del botin fueron pagadas, y el asunto fue sepultado en el mar.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Chaque homme a bord soupconnait le chirurgien, mais la mer a une maniere d'engloutir les preuves. La corde racontait une histoire, le registre une autre, et aucun ne parlait assez clairement pour un conseil de guerre. Graves fut confine dans sa cabine pour les trois jours restants, et le capitaine redigea un rapport qui satisfit l'amiraute sans satisfaire la justice. Les parts de prise furent versees, et l'affaire fut ensevelie en mer.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong man was clapped in irons, and Surgeon Graves kept his hands clean for the remainder of the voyage. The bosun or the carpenter — it hardly mattered which innocent wore the chains. The false accounts stayed hidden beneath the surgery cabin floor, the coin pouch undiscovered, and the prize shares were divided with Graves receiving his and Cole's portion besides. The sea tells no tales.
wrong_accusation.es: Al hombre equivocado le pusieron los grilletes, y el Cirujano Graves mantuvo sus manos limpias el resto del viaje. El contramaestre o el carpintero — poco importaba cual inocente llevara las cadenas. Las cuentas falsas permanecieron ocultas bajo el suelo de la cabina de cirugia, la bolsa de monedas sin descubrir, y las partes del botin se dividieron con Graves recibiendo la suya y la de Cole ademas. El mar no cuenta historias.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais homme fut mis aux fers, et le Chirurgien Graves garda les mains propres pour le reste du voyage. Le maitre d'equipage ou le charpentier — peu importait quel innocent portait les chaines. Les faux comptes resterent caches sous le plancher de la cabine de chirurgie, la bourse non decouverte, et les parts de prise furent reparties avec Graves recevant la sienne et celle de Cole en plus. La mer ne raconte pas d'histoires.

cold_case.en: The ship made port and the matter was handed to shore authorities who had no taste for naval disputes. The orlop hold was scrubbed, the prize chests counted and dispersed, and Quartermaster Cole's name was struck from the muster roll. The halyard was returned to the rigging, the false accounts never found, and the surgeon walked ashore with the rest of the crew. The black ledger sank with the ship's reputation.
cold_case.es: El barco llego a puerto y el asunto fue entregado a las autoridades de tierra, que no tenian apetito por disputas navales. La bodega fue fregada, los cofres de presas contados y dispersados, y el nombre del Contramaestre Cole fue tachado del registro de tripulacion. La driza fue devuelta a la jarcia, las cuentas falsas nunca encontradas, y el cirujano desembarco con el resto de la tripulacion. El libro negro se hundio con la reputacion del barco.
cold_case.fr: Le navire accosta et l'affaire fut confiee aux autorites a terre qui n'avaient aucun gout pour les differends navals. La cale fut recuree, les coffres de prises comptes et disperses, et le nom du Quartier-maitre Cole fut raye du role d'equipage. La drisse fut rendue au greement, les faux comptes jamais trouves, et le chirurgien debarqua avec le reste de l'equipage. Le registre noir sombra avec la reputation du navire.

lucky_guess.en: The surgeon's name was spoken more from the crew's distrust of medical men than from any solid proof. A left-handed coil, an ink stain — circumstance, not evidence. But the captain needed a name before port, and Graves fit the shape of guilt well enough. The court martial was brief, the verdict contested, and the sea kept whatever certainty it had to itself.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre del cirujano fue pronunciado mas por la desconfianza de la tripulacion hacia los hombres de medicina que por alguna prueba solida. Un enrollado a izquierdas, una mancha de tinta — circunstancia, no evidencia. Pero el capitan necesitaba un nombre antes de llegar a puerto, y Graves encajaba en la forma de la culpa lo suficientemente bien. El consejo de guerra fue breve, el veredicto disputado, y el mar guardo para si cualquier certeza que tuviera.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom du chirurgien fut prononce davantage par la mefiance de l'equipage envers les hommes de medecine que par une preuve solide. Un lovage a gauche, une tache d'encre — des circonstances, pas des preuves. Mais le capitaine avait besoin d'un nom avant le port, et Graves correspondait assez bien a la forme de la culpabilite. Le conseil de guerre fut bref, le verdict conteste, et la mer garda pour elle toute certitude qu'elle possedait.

expressions.suspect:surgeon_graves: Surgeon Graves rolled his sleeves down before presenting himself on deck. His hands were clean but the ink under his nails had not yet dried.
expressions.event:halyard_strangling: The signal halyard was looped twice around the neck and pulled from behind. The knot at the base was a surgeon's bend.
expressions.motive:prize_money_fraud: The prize ledger showed a shortfall of four hundred pounds across three captures. The false accounts were kept in a separate book in the surgery cabin.
expressions.suspect:bosun_flint: Bosun Flint stood at the rail with his belaying pin in hand. He had quarrelled with Cole over ration weights the previous watch.
expressions.suspect:captain_hale: Captain Hale kept the prize ledger locked in his cabin chest. He claimed he had not opened it since the last port call.
expressions.suspect:navigator_reid: Navigator Reid charted a course two points west of the agreed heading. His compass case held a folded note that was not a bearing.
expressions.suspect:powder_monkey_sam: Sam carried rum to the gun deck at the start of the middle watch. He said he heard nothing from the hold below.
expressions.suspect:first_mate_darcy: First Mate Darcy had the watch and was responsible for all movement on deck. His log entry for the middle watch is four lines shorter than usual.
expressions.suspect:carpenter_hook: Carpenter Hook had patched a seam in the orlop hold that afternoon. His tools were still below when the body was found.
expressions.location:gun_deck: The gun deck runs the length of the ship between the main hatch and the stern. The lanterns were doused for the middle watch.
expressions.location:orlop_hold: The orlop hold sits below the gun deck and holds cargo and stores. Cole's body lay between two prize chests with the halyard around his neck.
expressions.location:surgery_cabin: The surgery cabin is aft of the hold, separated by a canvas screen. A desk holds ink, quill, and two ledgers bound in different leather.
expressions.location:main_deck: The main deck is open to the sky and swept by wind. The rigging overhead creaks with each roll of the hull.
expressions.location:captains_cabin: The captain's cabin holds a chart table and a locked sea chest. The key hangs on a cord around Captain Hale's neck.
expressions.location:rigging_platform: The rigging platform sits thirty feet above the main deck. A signal halyard runs from the platform to a cleat on the starboard rail.
expressions.location:forecastle: The forecastle holds the crew's hammocks and the watch bell. The bell was struck at four bells but no one answered from the hold.
expressions.location:stores_locker: The stores locker is bolted from outside and holds rum, biscuit, and coin. The bolt was found drawn back at dawn muster.
expressions.object:prize_ledger: The prize ledger records the value of each captured cargo by date and port. Three entries show sums lower than the manifest totals.
expressions.object:signal_halyard: A signal halyard was cut from the starboard rigging and found in the hold. The fibre matches the rope stock used for signalling.
expressions.object:false_accounts: A second set of accounts was found in the surgery cabin desk. The figures are written in the same hand as the prize ledger corrections.
expressions.object:watch_bell: The watch bell was struck at four bells of the middle watch. No one reported hearing it from below.
expressions.object:rum_ration_log: The rum ration log shows a discrepancy of eight pints over the past fortnight. The missing rum was not reported to the captain.
expressions.object:neck_bruise: The bruise around Cole's neck shows a double loop consistent with a halyard. The pressure was applied from behind and above.
expressions.object:coin_pouch: A coin pouch was found beneath the surgery cabin floorboard. The coins include gold from three different prize captures.
expressions.object:belaying_pin: A belaying pin from the main deck rail shows a fresh dent. The dent does not match any recent rigging work.
expressions.object:ink_and_quill: The quill on the surgery desk matches the ink used in the false accounts. The nib width is consistent with the ledger corrections.
expressions.object:locked_chest: The captain's sea chest was found with its wax seal broken. The lid showed no tool marks but the lock had been turned.
expressions.object:torn_manifest: A cargo manifest was found torn in half in the stores locker. The torn section listed cargo values from the last prize.
expressions.object:compass_case: Navigator Reid's compass case held a folded note listing three port agents. One name appears in the false accounts.
expressions.object:bloodied_rope: A length of rope with blood on one end was found coiled behind a barrel in the hold. The coil was left-handed.
expressions.emotion:steady_nerve: He answered each question without shifting his weight. His voice was level and his gaze held the middle distance.
expressions.emotion:blunt_denial: He struck the rail with his palm and said he had nothing to do with it. His denial came before the question was finished.
expressions.emotion:clipped_tone: Every answer was precisely two sentences. He did not elaborate and he did not look at the body.
expressions.emotion:averted_look: He turned to face the sea when asked about the chest. His hand moved to the key on his cord.
expressions.emotion:false_grief: He removed his cap and pressed it to his chest. His condolence was fluent and his eyes moved to the surgery cabin door.
expressions.emotion:quiet_rage: He said nothing when shown the ration log. His jaw tightened and he looked toward the rigging.
expressions.modifier:rope_coiled_wrong: The rope in the hold was coiled left-handed. Sailors coil right-handed by training; a surgeon would not know the convention.
expressions.modifier:ink_smudge: An ink smudge on the false accounts matches the ink on Graves's right forefinger. The smudge is still tacky.
expressions.modifier:lantern_doused: All gun deck lanterns were doused for the middle watch as standard. The hold was completely dark after the last bell.
expressions.modifier:figures_wrong: Three prize entries in the ledger show values lower than the corresponding manifests. The differences total four hundred pounds.
expressions.modifier:hatch_unbolted: The orlop hatch was found unbolted at dawn. Standing orders require it bolted during the night watch.
expressions.modifier:knot_surgeons: The knot at the base of the halyard loop is a surgeon's bend. It is not used in standard rigging practice.
expressions.modifier:wax_seal_broken: The wax seal on the captain's chest was broken cleanly. The wax colour matches a stick found in the surgery cabin.
expressions.modifier:fibre_match: The fibres from the halyard match the rope stock on the rigging platform. The stock is used only for signal lines.
expressions.modifier:pin_dent: The dent on the belaying pin is consistent with a downward blow. No rigging task would produce this mark.
expressions.modifier:gold_dust_residue: Gold dust was found on the inside of the coin pouch and on the false accounts. The dust matches gold from the last prize.
expressions.action:ledger_doctored: Three entries in the prize ledger were altered to show reduced cargo values. The original figures are visible beneath the overwriting.
expressions.action:halyard_cut: A signal halyard was cut from the starboard rigging between eight bells and four bells. The cut was made with a sharp blade.
expressions.action:hold_entered: Someone entered the orlop hold through the unbolted hatch during the middle watch. The hatch bolt was found drawn back.
expressions.action:chest_opened: The captain's sea chest was opened using a wax impression of the lock. The impression was made from the key on the captain's cord.
expressions.action:body_moved: The body was positioned between two prize chests after death. The drag marks on the hold floor run from the hatch ladder.
expressions.action:rum_served: Rum was served to the gun deck watch at the start of the middle watch. Sam carried the measure and poured for six men.
expressions.action:manifest_checked: The torn manifest was checked against the prize ledger entries. The values on the manifest are higher than those recorded.
expressions.action:accounts_compared: The false accounts in the surgery cabin were compared with the prize ledger. The handwriting matches on seven of nine criteria.
expressions.action:rope_discarded: The bloodied rope was coiled and hidden behind a barrel in the hold. The blood had not fully dried when found.
expressions.time:middle_watch: The middle watch runs from midnight to four in the morning. The crew on watch numbered eight, including the first mate.
expressions.time:bell_struck: The watch bell was struck at two-hour intervals. Four bells sounded at 02:00 and no reply came from below.
expressions.time:dawn_muster: Dawn muster was called at six. The quartermaster did not answer and the search began.
expressions.time:cargo_count: A cargo count was scheduled for the morning before port. Cole had requested it to verify the prize totals.
expressions.time:port_arrival: The ship was due in port within three days. At port, the prize shares would be calculated from the ledger.
expressions.motive:gold_skim: Graves had skimmed gold from three prize captures over four months. The hidden coin pouch held his accumulated share.
expressions.motive:share_dispute: Navigator Reid claimed his prize share was calculated short. He had raised the matter with Cole the previous week.
expressions.motive:audit_prevention: Cole had requested a full cargo count before port. The count would have exposed the discrepancy between the ledger and the manifests.
expressions.motive:command_ambition: First Mate Darcy believed the quartermasters authority exceeded his station. He had petitioned the captain for expanded watch powers.
expressions.motive:old_score: Carpenter Hook had served under Cole on a previous ship. A dispute over timber stores had ended with Hook receiving twelve lashes.
expressions.witness:lookout: The lookout saw no one on the rigging platform during the middle watch. He was facing forward and the platform is aft.
expressions.witness:helmsman: The helmsman held the wheel from midnight to four. He heard the bell struck but no sounds from below deck.
expressions.witness:cook: The cook rose at five to prepare the morning meal. He found the stores locker bolt drawn and the rum measure unwashed.
expressions.witness:gunner: The gunner slept on the gun deck and woke at dawn muster. He reported a sound from the hold at approximately three bells.
expressions.witness:cabin_boy: The cabin boy delivered coffee to the captain at five. He noticed the surgery cabin lamp was still burning.
expressions.event:quartermaster_cole_discovered: Quartermaster Cole was found in the orlop hold between two prize chests. The signal halyard was wrapped around his neck and his eyes were open.
expressions.event:cargo_inspection: The cargo inspection was ordered by Cole to verify prize values before port. The inspection was to begin at dawn muster.
